已隐藏敏感值。二进制正文需开启私密原文查看。: Sensitive values are hidden. Enable private originals to inspect binary bodies.
默认移除认证、Cookie 和密钥字段。重放会向目标地址发送实际请求。: Authentication, cookies, and secret fields are removed by default. Replaying sends a real request to the destination.
运行查询后查看数据。: Run a query to view its data.
文件查询仅访问选定数据。CSV 小数保留为文本，可显式 CAST 为 DECIM: File queries access only selected data. CSV decimal literals stay as text; use an explicit CAST to DECIMAL.
连接串使用 postgresql:// 或 mysql://；用户名与密码也可在: Use a postgresql:// or mysql:// connection URL. Credentials can also be entered in Auth. Cancellation closes the connection; write outcomes may be unknown.
仅显示部分结构，查询仍可直接使用完整表名。: The schema is partial. Queries can still use full table names.
运行光标所在的语句；有选区时仅运行选区。连接环境修改后重连生效。: Run the statement at the cursor, or the selected text. Reconnect to apply changes to the connection environment.
结果事件已被淘汰，请重新运行查询。: Result events were evicted. Run the query again.
已请求取消并关闭连接，写入结果可能未知。: Cancellation requested and connection closed. Write outcomes may be unknown.
文件超过 20 MiB 导入限制。: File exceeds the 20 MiB import limit.
SQL 语法结构有误，请检查括号或引号。: Check SQL grouping, brackets or quotes.
导出全部已返回行。JSON 保留类型；CSV 空单元格表示 NULL，公式会转义: Exports all returned rows. JSON preserves types; CSV uses empty cells for NULL and escapes formulas.
连接在查询完成前关闭，请重新连接。: The connection closed before the query finished. Reconnect to continue.
请求体源数据有误，请修正 JSON 配置。: Invalid body source. Correct the JSON configuration.
文件总量最多 5 MiB。默认导出不包含文件字节；上传响应仅保留在实时视图。: Files/text total at most 5 MiB. Default exports omit file bytes; upload responses remain live-only.
multipart 边界由工具生成，手动 Content-Type 需禁用。支持: The multipart boundary is generated. Disable manual Content-Type headers. Repeated names are supported.
切换文件模式时，已有 Content-Type 会被禁用，原值保留在请求头中。: Switching to a file mode disables existing Content-Type headers. Their values stay in the header list.
HMAC 使用密钥文本；RSA、EC、EdDSA 使用私钥 PEM。不读取文件路: HMAC uses a secret; RSA, EC and EdDSA use private PEM. File paths are never read.
缺失时自动添加 iat 和 exp: Add iat and exp if absent
收到 401 Digest challenge 后自动签名并重试；跨域重定向不携: Signs and retries after a 401 Digest challenge. Cross-origin redirects do not carry auth.
鉴权在执行时解析环境变量。默认导出移除密钥；JWT 每次执行生成。: Auth resolves environment variables on execution. Default exports omit keys; JWT is generated per run.
执行时使用最近目录、集合或工作区的鉴权；No Auth 停止继承。: Uses the nearest folder, collection or workspace auth at execution. No Auth stops inheritance.
父级变量和鉴权在执行时继承；保存工作区后同步这些设置。: Parent variables and authentication are inherited at execution. Save the workspace to sync these settings.
同名变量按父级到子级覆盖，环境变量优先于集合变量。: Child variables override parent variables. Environment variables take precedence over collection variables.
删除「{{value0}}」及其所有子目录和请求。保存后生效。: Delete “{{value0}}” with every descendant folder and request. Takes effect after saving.
目录层级无效或超过限制: The folder hierarchy is invalid or exceeds the depth limit.
目录不能移动到自身或子目录: A folder cannot be moved into itself or its descendants.
目录设置在编辑期间已变更，请重新打开设置: Folder settings changed while editing. Reopen the settings to continue.
执行时解析环境变量后确定: Determined after variables resolve at execution
本地变量更新未完成，请重试: Local variable updates were not completed. Try again.
目录变量仅保留源定义；启用后由 MoleAPI 在请求中解析。: Folder variables are retained as source only. Enable them to resolve them in MoleAPI requests.
权限范围以空格分隔，可引用环境变量。: Separate scopes with spaces. Environment references are supported.
执行时自动刷新过期 Token: Automatically refresh expired tokens during execution
Token 凭据独立保存在当前账户与工作区，不随工作区默认导出或同步。: Token credentials are stored separately for this account and workspace. Workspace export and sync do not include them.
凭据仅用于当前账户和工作区。授权后选择 Token，再发送请求。: Credentials belong to this account and workspace. Authorize and select a token before sending requests.
粘贴授权后的回调 URL: Paste the redirect URL after authorization
回调 URL 缺少 state: The redirect URL is missing state.
在授权服务中注册以下回调 URI，并设置到当前配置：: Register this redirect URI with the provider and use it in this configuration:
授权服务确认 Token 有效: The provider confirms this token is active.
授权服务确认 Token 无效: The provider reports this token is inactive.
粘贴包含 access_token 和 token_type 的响应，可选 re: Paste a response containing access_token and token_type, optionally refresh_token, expires_in and scope. Credentials are stored only in this account's private token vault.
Token 响应必须是有效 JSON: The token response must be valid JSON.
根据实际发送的请求生成签名。凭据可引用环境变量；S3 自动使用专用路径和校验设置: Sign the actual outgoing request. Credentials support environment references; S3 uses its dedicated path and checksum settings.
留空时自动生成随机值，可引用环境变量。: Leave empty for a random value; environment references are supported.
留空时使用发送时间，可引用环境变量。: Leave empty to use the send time; environment references are supported.
应用与委托参与签名。启用请求体哈希时，按实际发送的内容和 MIME 类型计算。: Application and delegation attributes are authenticated. Payload hashing uses the actual transmitted content and MIME type.
令牌来自旧配置版本，请重新获取或导入；工作区和原始配置已保留。: This token uses an older profile version. Acquire or import it again; the workspace and original configuration are preserved.
Cookie 按账号、工作区和当前环境隔离，仅保存在进程内存中；退出账号或重启后: Cookies are isolated by account, workspace and current environment. They stay in process memory, are cleared on logout or restart, and are excluded from sync and exports.
用于 HTTP、SOAP 和 GraphQL 查询；手动 Cookie Head: Used for HTTP, SOAP and GraphQL queries. Manual Cookie headers take precedence. Other protocols do not use this jar.
当前环境没有 Cookie。: No cookies in the current environment.
输入一个完整 Set-Cookie 值，例如 sid=value; Path=/: Enter one full Set-Cookie value, such as sid=value; Path=/; HttpOnly. Add the same domain, path and name again to update a cookie.
支持 PKCS8 和 PKCS1，密钥长度为 2048–4096 位。: Supports PKCS8 and PKCS1 keys from 2048 to 4096 bits.
表单位置要求 application/x-www-form-urlencoded: Body placement requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded and retains original form fields.
POST/PUT 表单使用请求体，其他请求使用查询参数。: POST/PUT forms use the body; other requests use query parameters.
留空时每次请求生成新的随机值。: Leave blank to generate a new random value for each request.
留空时使用当前 Unix 秒数，手动值必须为正整数。: Leave blank for current Unix seconds. Manual values must be positive integers.
签名使用实际 URL 和请求体，支持环境变量及父级继承。此面板配置请求签名；OA: Signs the actual URL and body with variables and inherited authentication. This panel configures request signing; OAuth1 authorization and automatic token acquisition are not available yet.
PLAINTEXT 签名包含共享密钥，请使用 HTTPS 保护传输。: PLAINTEXT signatures contain shared secrets. Use HTTPS to protect transport.
Token 与 Secret 仅保存在当前账户的工作区私有令牌库，不参与同步或导: Tokens and secrets stay in the current account and workspace private vault, excluded from sync and exports.
未选择私有 Token，使用手动凭据。: No private token selected; using manual credentials.
手动输入 PIN 或回调 URL: Enter PIN or callback URL manually
注册此基础回调 URI。MoleAPI 会自动附加随机 state，并校验回调中: Register this base callback URI. MoleAPI adds random state and validates the request token in the callback.
删除只移除本地凭据，不会撤销授权服务中的 Token。OAuth1 没有统一的刷: Deleting removes local credentials without revoking the provider token. OAuth1 has no standard refresh or revocation endpoint.
OAuth1 Verifier / PIN 或回调 URL: OAuth1 verifier / PIN or callback URL
请输入 OAuth1 Verifier 或回调 URL: Enter an OAuth1 verifier or callback URL
签名使用实际 URL 和请求体，支持环境变量及父级继承。选择私有 Token 后: Signs the actual URL and body with variables and inherited authentication. Selected private tokens use vault credentials at execution time.
域留空时可在用户名中使用 DOMAIN\\user 或 user@domain。: Leave domain blank to use DOMAIN\user or user@domain in the username.
HTTPS 使用 TLS 通道绑定: Use TLS channel binding for HTTPS
使用 NTLMv2，握手保持在同一条 HTTP/1.1 连接中。不会读取系统登录: Uses NTLMv2 on one HTTP/1.1 connection with explicit credentials. A closed connection stops authentication; cross-origin redirects do not receive credentials.
留空使用实际请求 Host；覆盖只影响签名 Host，不修改实际请求地址。: Leave blank for the actual request host. An override affects signing authority only, leaving the transport URL unchanged.
按顺序使用英文逗号分隔；每个名称可引用环境变量。: Use comma-separated names in signing order. Each name can reference a variable.
POST 只哈希这些前缀字节，完整请求体仍会发送；其他方法不哈希请求体。: POST hashes only this byte prefix; the complete body is still sent. Other methods do not hash their bodies.
格式为 yyyyMMddTHH:mm:ss+0000；留空使用当前 UTC 时间: Use yyyyMMddTHH:mm:ss+0000. Leave blank for current UTC time.
使用 EG1-HMAC-SHA256 签名实际请求。凭据支持变量和继承；跨域重定: Signs the actual request with EG1-HMAC-SHA256, variables and inherited credentials. Cross-origin redirects do not receive the signature.
支持 PKCS8、RSA PKCS1、EC SEC1 PEM 和带 kid 的: Supports PKCS8, RSA PKCS1, EC SEC1 PEM and PKCS8 data URIs with kid. No file paths or remote key loading.
多个 Audience 按顺序用英文逗号分隔，每项可使用变量。: Use comma-separated audiences in order. Each entry can reference a variable.
Claims 优先于独立字段；未提供时自动生成 jti、iat 和 exp。字符: Claims override individual fields. Missing jti, iat and exp are generated. String variables resolve safely within JSON.
每次执行生成新的 ASAP Bearer Token，支持变量和父级继承。默认导: Generates an ASAP bearer token for each execution with variables and inherited authentication. Default exports and history hide keys and generated tokens.
ASAP 使用 Postman Runtime 扩展；官方 Collection: ASAP uses a Postman Runtime extension absent from the official Collection 2.1 schema.
仅用于 HTTP、SOAP 和有限 GraphQL 请求。支持环境变量；停用后保: For HTTP, SOAP and finite GraphQL requests. Variables are supported; disabling preserves drafts.
HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS 代理。托管服务需管理员允许私网访问；代理负责远: HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy. Hosted servers require administrator permission for private-network access; proxies control remote resolution.
英文逗号分隔域名、IP 或 CIDR；* 绕过所有地址。: Comma-separated domains, IPs or CIDRs; * bypasses all addresses.
只有一个身份时可留空；多个身份需填写别名。: Leave empty for a single identity; specify an alias for multiple identities.
证书与密钥保存在请求源中；默认导出会移除，需显式包含敏感信息进行备份。: Certificates and keys are stored in request source. Default exports remove them; explicitly include sensitive values for backups.
将主机映射到 IP，保留原始 Host 与 TLS 名称。受限服务端仍会拒绝私网: Map hosts to IPs while preserving the original Host and TLS name. Restricted servers still reject private addresses.
无法读取证书文件：检查编码及大小（PEM 128 KiB、私钥 64 KiB、P: Unable to read certificate file: check encoding and size (PEM 128 KiB, key 64 KiB, PFX 192 KiB).
gRPC 使用 HTTP/2；TLS、DNS 和代理配置同样适用。: gRPC uses HTTP/2; TLS, DNS and proxy settings also apply.
TCP 使用原始套接字；tcps:// 支持 CA 和客户端证书。: TCP uses raw sockets; tcps:// supports CA and client certificates.
适用于 HTTP、SOAP、SSE、WebSocket、GraphQL、gRPC: For HTTP, SOAP, SSE, WebSocket, GraphQL, gRPC, TCP, MQTT, Socket.IO, A2A and MCP HTTP requests. Variables are supported; disabling preserves drafts.
MQTT 的 TCP/TLS 和 WebSocket 传输共用网络设置，WebS: MQTT TCP/TLS and WebSocket transports share network settings; WebSocket upgrades use HTTP/1.1.
网络设置在下一次发送或连接时应用；现有会话需要重新连接。: Network settings apply to the next send or connection; reconnect existing sessions to apply changes.
基于原始 OpenAPI 定义生成独立项目，不覆盖已有代码，也不执行或发布生成结: Generate a separate project from original OpenAPI definitions. Existing code is preserved; generated output is neither executed nor published.
此生成器需要部署方配置 Java 17+。原生 Rust SDK 不需要 Jav: This generator requires Java 17+ configured by the deployment owner. Native Rust SDK generation does not require Java.
上游生成器目录不代表每个目标都经过编译验证；请验证生成项目后再使用。: The upstream generator catalog does not imply compile validation for every target. Validate generated projects before use.
包含敏感信息（生成文件可能包含凭据）: Include sensitive values (generated files may contain credentials)
无法读取项目生成器，请关闭后重试。: Unable to load project generators. Close and try again.
项目生成失败，请检查规范、生成器选项和运行时依赖。: Project generation failed. Check the definition, generator options and runtime dependencies.
二进制文件可下载查看。: Download this binary file to inspect it.
原生 Rust 生成器支持 OpenAPI 3.0；3.1 请使用其他生成器。: The native Rust generator supports OpenAPI 3.0. Use another generator for 3.1.
比较旧生成快照、当前编辑快照与新生成结果。只输出新归档，不覆盖原文件；冲突需要明: Compare the previous generated snapshot, current edits and new output. Export a new archive without overwriting originals; resolve conflicts explicitly.
从生成窗口保存快照；当前编辑快照可修改 content 或添加文件，删除条目代表: Save a snapshot from the generation window. Edit content or add files in the current snapshot; removing an entry means deleting that file. Keep the original snapshot and hashes intact.
无法比较项目，请检查快照 JSON、文件校验和及大小限制。: Unable to compare projects. Check snapshot JSON, file hashes and size limits.
此目标需要部署方显式配置 protoc。原生 Rust gRPC 生成不需要外部: This target requires explicitly configured protoc. Native Rust gRPC generation needs no external compiler.
当前生成 Protobuf 消息类型；gRPC 服务接口需要配置对应语言的插件。: This target currently generates Protobuf message types; gRPC service interfaces require the corresponding language plugin.
项目导入失败：最多 2048 个文件，每个 4 MiB，项目 8 MiB，ZIP: Project import failed: up to 2048 files, 4 MiB per file, 8 MiB per project and 10 MiB per ZIP. Links and unsafe paths are not allowed.
比较旧生成项目、当前编辑文件与新生成结果。支持快照 JSON、ZIP 和当前项目: Compare the previous generated project, current edits and new output. Import snapshot JSON, ZIP or a current project directory; resolve conflicts explicitly.
使用未修改的生成快照或原始项目 ZIP，校验和必须一致。: Use an unchanged generation snapshot or original project ZIP with matching hashes.
读取整个项目：新增文件会保留，缺失文件视为删除。: Import the whole project: added files are preserved and missing files are treated as deletions.
目录导入跳过 .git、.svn、.hg、node_modules、target: Directory imports skip .git, .svn, .hg, node_modules, target, .venv and __pycache__; ZIP imports retain their files. Import and merge do not overwrite originals.
旧生成 {{previous}} 个文件，当前编辑 {{working}} 个文: Previous: {{previous}} files; current: {{working}} files; new: {{next}} files.
无法导入项目，请检查 ZIP 或快照、原始校验和、文件类型与大小限制。: Unable to import the project. Check the ZIP or snapshot, original hashes, file types and size limits.
选择已记录，可继续处理其他冲突；点击比较并合并后应用全部选择。: Choice recorded. Continue resolving other conflicts, then compare and merge to apply all choices.
读取目录或 ZIP 中的 JSON、YAML 和 schema 文件，选择入口定: Read JSON, YAML and schema files from a directory or ZIP and select the entry definition. Keep original files; resolve references during project generation.
最多 64 个源文件，源包总计 1 MiB。只解析提供的文件，不读取外部文件或联: Up to 64 source files and 1 MiB per bundle. Resolve only supplied files, without external file reads or network access. Some advanced reference semantics remain incomplete.
无法读取或保存源包，请检查 UTF8、文件路径、大小和入口的 OpenAPI 版: Unable to read or save the bundle. Check UTF8, paths, size and the entry OpenAPI version.
将当前保存的 HTTP 请求转换为所选语言的请求代码，支持预览、复制和下载。默认: Generate request code for the saved HTTP endpoint in your selected language. Preview, copy or download; credentials are hidden by default.
RestSharp 示例需要对应 NuGet 包和 RestSharp 命名空间: RestSharp snippets need its NuGet package and the RestSharp namespace. JSON raw strings require C# 11 or newer. Use an async method or a project supporting top-level await.
HttpClient 示例需要 System.Net.Http 和 System: HttpClient snippets need the System.Net.Http and System.Net.Http.Headers namespaces. JSON raw strings require C# 11 or newer. Use an async method or a project supporting top-level await.
生成静态请求示例；不执行脚本、不解析环境变量、不附加浏览器私有覆盖。请检查占位符: Generates a static request example without running scripts, resolving environment variables or attaching private browser overrides. Review placeholders.
各语言的超时、TLS、重定向策略由其 HTTP 库决定；此轮示例尚不映射这些设置: Timeout, TLS and redirect behavior depends on the target HTTP library; snippets do not yet map these settings.
语言与 HTTP 库按 Apifox／Postman 官方请求代码列表提供；库依: Languages and HTTP libraries follow the official Apifox/Postman request-code lists. Install library dependencies in the target project.
此选项生成 Node.js CommonJS 代码；Request、Unires: This option generates Node.js CommonJS code. Install dependencies such as Request, Unirest and follow-redirects as indicated by require statements.
此选项生成 Postman CLI 命令，需要目标环境安装该 CLI；生成过程不: This option generates Postman CLI commands and requires that CLI in the target environment. Generation does not execute commands.
生成 SDK / 服务端项目 / 数据模型: Generate SDK / server project / data models
留空或 * 生成全部 components.schemas；填写名称只生成该模型: Leave blank or use * for all components.schemas. Enter a name to generate that model and its referenced types.
模型代码风格与序列化选项: Model code style and serialization options
显式覆盖上游 .mustache 文件；目录或 ZIP 内路径应相对模板根目录。: Override upstream .mustache files explicitly. Directory and ZIP paths must be relative to the template root. Up to 128 files, 64 KiB each, 512 KiB total.
模板导入失败，请检查文件格式、路径、UTF-8 编码和大小限制。: Template import failed. Check the file format, paths, UTF-8 encoding and size limits.
API 和 Model 类型按接口或模型生成文件，名称字段是后缀；Support: API and Model types generate files per API or model, using the filename as a suffix. SupportingFiles generates a single extra file. Apply mappings before generation.
输出映射无效，请检查文件名、目录、重复目标和保留的清单路径。: Invalid output mapping. Check the filename, folder, duplicate destinations and reserved manifest paths.
导入 .mustache 模板或 UTF-8 静态文件，路径相对模板根目录。最多: Import .mustache templates or UTF-8 static files with paths relative to the template root. Up to 128 files, 64 KiB each, 512 KiB total. Static files are copied through output mappings.
导入 UTF-8 Mustache 模板及文本、图片等静态资源，路径相对模板根目: Import UTF-8 Mustache templates and static assets such as text or images, with paths relative to the template root. Up to 128 files, 64 KiB each, 512 KiB per bundle. Static assets are copied through output mappings.
二进制静态资源保留原始字节，生成时按输出映射复制。: Binary static assets retain their original bytes and are copied using their output mappings.
文件上传代码引用文件名，不嵌入保存的文件字节。运行代码前请在目标环境准备对应文件: File upload code references filenames without embedding saved file bytes. Prepare the corresponding files in the target environment before running, and check the library's MIME type and filename behavior.
当前显示可读取原始文件字节的适配器；其他正文类型仍可选择完整语言与库列表。: Showing adapters that read original file bytes. Other body types retain the full language and library catalog.
文件超过 {{limit}} MiB 导入限制。: File exceeds the {{limit}} MiB import limit.
CSV 使用表头，JSON 使用对象数组；数据仅用于本次运行，可通过变量占位符和: CSV uses headers; JSON uses an array of objects. Data applies only to this run and is available through variable placeholders and pm.iterationData. Up to 100 rows and 1 MiB.
测试数据无效，请检查格式、迭代次数和大小限制。: Invalid test data. Check the format, iteration count and size limits.
集合运行达到时间限制。: Collection run reached its time limit.
集合运行达到变量大小限制。: Collection run reached its variable size limit.
响应详情因报告大小限制被省略。: Response details omitted because of the report size limit.
数据集随工作区保存和同步。默认备份隐藏私密数据源；包含私密值的备份保留原文。: Datasets are saved and synchronized with the workspace. Default backups hide private sources; backups including private values retain the original source.
数据源缺失，请重新导入。: Data source missing. Import its data again.
私密数据集（默认备份不包含数据源）: Private dataset (source excluded from default backups)
数据集保存失败，请检查数据、名称、大小或工作区版本冲突。未保存的编辑保留在工作区: Dataset save failed. Check the data, name, size or workspace revision conflict. Unsaved edits remain in the workspace draft.
数据集保存失败，请检查数据、名称、大小或工作区版本冲突。未保存的编辑已保留。: Dataset save failed. Check the data, name, size or workspace revision conflict. Unsaved edits are retained.
